messages:
incident-bot: Paging: High 5xx rate (+timeout) and elevated p50/p95 latency for text-generation in eu-west-1. Alert INC-1995012345. Trigger: downstream queue backlog > 10k, errors spike to 14%.

aisha (oncall): I’m up — looking now. Attaching baseline: p50 ~ 80ms normally, p50 now ~620ms. Hit the runbook.

mike (infra): I can scale dedicated pool in eu-west-1 by +2 nodes, but cold start for GPUs is ~8m. Recommend immediate traffic reroute to eu-central-1 and us-west-2 while we bring capacity.

kevin (eng-sre): Agreed. Rolling route change now:
```
# temporary routing command
rts route set --service=text-gen --from-region=eu-west-1 --fallback=eu-central-1,us-west-2 --policy=latency-preferred
```

kevin (eng-sre): Pushed rule. Please monitor for increased tail latency from fallback regions.

incident-bot: Routing rule applied (rule-id r-8b3f). Observability: 5xx in eu-west-1 down from 14% -> 2.2% in 3m, global error rate stable.

aisha (oncall): Good. Initiating reduced throughput mode to shed bursty long-running requests: set batch_max_tokens=256 and disable KV prefetch for eu-west-1.

mike (infra): Scaling started (allocating 2x g4dn). ETA nodes ready: 7m.

olivia (support): Drafting customer comms — will push to affected customers list. Anyone want to review before I send an external note?

kevin (eng-sre): Quick internal status page update draft (post as "Investigating"):
```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Partial degradation of text-generation in eu-west-1. Some requests may see increased latency (p50 up to ~600ms) or return 500 errors.
Scope: A subset of customers in EU regions routed to eu-west-1.
Mitigation: Traffic temporarily routed to fallback regions (eu-central-1, us-west-2). Engineers are scaling capacity in eu-west-1.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when root cause found.
```

olivia (support): Copy for customer email (short):
```
Subject: Service degradation impacting text-generation (EU) — temporary mitigation in place

Hi —
We’re investigating a partial degradation of our text-generation service in the EU (eu-west-1). Some requests may experience higher latency or errors. We have rerouted traffic to fallback regions and are scaling regional capacity.

No customer data was exposed.
We expect a follow-up within 30 minutes.
We apologize for the disruption. If you need immediate assistance or want us to prioritize a tenant, reply here or open a support ticket.

— Redwood Inference Status Team
```

olivia (support): I’ll send the notice to the impacted customers list after Aisha confirms mitigation is stable.

aisha (oncall): Go ahead and send to "impacted-eu-tenants" distribution but mark as "We have mitigation in place"; include escalation contact: support@redwood.ai.

sanjay (billing): Heads up — if this becomes >=30m of degraded service for an account we need customer IDs to calculate SLA credits. Please capture tenant IDs and percentage of time degraded. I’ll prep the credit transactions.

kevin (eng-sre): Logging snippet during the spike if useful:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:02Z eu-west-1 text-gen svc=frontend request_id=abcd1234 latency=1201ms error=502 queue_depth=12456
2026-03-15T09:12:07Z eu-west-1 text-gen svc=frontend request_id=abcd1239 latency=980ms error=504 queue_depth=12780
```

mike (infra): Nodes are in progress, kernel module warmups happening. If warm starts don’t finish in 12m we’ll failover permanently until we can reprovision.

olivia (support): Sent external email to impacted list (marked P1). Snippet of outbound: "We have rerouted traffic and are working on capacity, more updates soon".

incident-bot: Alert update: global 5xx back to baseline 0.8%, eu-west-1 still at 2.2% but trending down.

aisha (oncall): OK — handing to Mike for ongoing capacity work and billing triage. I’m out in 50m. Mike, see runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/incidents/text-gen-eu

mike (infra): Taking over. Current action items: (1) finish scale up in eu-west-1, (2) validate KV cache integrity post-restart, (3) watch for cold LLM kernel failures. I’ll keep posting 10m cadence updates.

kevin (eng-sre): For SLA eligibility — quick checklist:
- Incident window start: 1995012345 (root alert).
- Mitigation applied (traffic reroute) at 1995012400 (~55s later).
- Full service restoration target: when eu-west p95 < 300ms and 5xx < 0.5% for 30m window.

sanjay (billing): Using our SLA policy: partial-platform degradation that impacts request success rates qualifies for credits if an account experienced >5% error rate or availability <99.95% over a billing day OR sustained region-level degradation >30m. For initial set, we should flag tenants with >10% error at peak and >20% of their requests during the incident from eu-west-1. I’ll run the query once we have tenant list.

olivia (support): Putting together list now — will paste tenant IDs below in 10m.

kevin (eng-sre): One more internal comm (ops to finance): propose provisional credit bucket for impacted tenants: 3%-10% monthly credit based on severity. We’ll finalize after postmortem.

sanjay (billing): Acknowledged. I’ll prepare a billing draft and a spreadsheet template so support can populate tenant rows: tenant_id, impacted_minutes, perc_requests_failed, eligible_credit_pct.

liz (prod): For public status page: once Mike confirms stable for 30m we should post "Identified & Mitigating -> Resolved" timeline. We'll also post a follow-up explaining root cause and credits policy.

mike (infra): eu-west nodes are active. Metrics show p50 back ~95ms, p95 ~340ms, 5xx at 0.6%. Still above target p95 but improving. Will monitor.

kevin (eng-sre): Reminder: include deployment hashes if we determine a recent rollout contributed. Check deploy-bot logs.

deploy-bot: deploy report: service=text-gen service-release=v2.3.7 deployed eu-west-1 @ 1995009000 by autobot. No recent config changes since then.

olivia (support): Tenant list (preliminary):
- tenant_8301
- tenant_9143
- tenant_9982
- tenant_10221
(I’ll add per-tenant error %, impacted minutes in the spreadsheet shortly.)

aisha (oncall): Thanks team. Mike — please take the handoff fully. I’ll add notes to on-call log and link the incident in the pager history. I’m moving to standby.

mike (infra): Will do. Next update in 10m or earlier if anything regresses. Also looping in Sanjay/finance after we finalize tenant impact list to start manual credit issuance if needed.

sanjay (billing): Once spreadsheet is filled, I’ll run the credit calc and request billing ops to apply prorated credits to affected accounts. Pre-approval for up to 5% credit granted by finance lead for incidents <2h, escalate for >5%.

kevin (eng-sre): Postmortem action items (to capture now):
- Confirm root cause (resource contention / kernel combo)
- Improve cold-start capacity playbook for gpu nodes
- Add automated tenant-impact export for billing
- Update SLA comms template with explicit credit tiers

olivia (support): Uploaded the customer-facing follow-up draft to the drive: https://internal.redwood/docs/incidents/1995012345-followup-draft

mike (infra): Marking this thread as handoff. Filing runbook ticket and leaving monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1995012345 acknowledged handoff to mike. Monitoring channel remains open.

kevin (eng-sre): Closing note for record: we applied a cross-region routing fallback in ~1m, scaled eu-west in ~9m, and achieved stabilization (p95 < 350ms, 5xx < 1%) by ~1995012945. Preparing timeline for postmortem.

olivia (support): Final: support team will send individualized credit eligibility notices after billing signoff.

mike (infra): Handoff complete.
